recipe.visualDefinition: A minimalist, high-key composition featuring a central photographic portrait fragment overlaid with a hand-drawn grid and loose sketches, framed by significant white negative space and structured serif typography.
coreVisualRelationships: Central photographic focal point vs. expansive white background
Rigid geometric grid lines vs. loose organic sketch marks
Boxed display characters at the top vs. italicized body text at the bottom
High-contrast facial features vs. washed-out skin tones
coreInvariants: Off-white or cream-colored paper texture background
Central square containing a cropped face
Thin black line-work for grids and boxes

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: A small, square photographic crop of a face is centered vertically and horizontally within the upper two-thirds of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The central eyes of the portrait act as the primary anchor, supported by the three boxed letters at the top.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Top-down vertical flow: starting at the boxed letters, moving to the central portrait, and ending at the italicized text at the bottom.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Extensive white space occupies approximately 70% of the canvas, creating a sense of clinical or artistic isolation.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation overall with high value (brightness); the only saturated elements are the lips and eyes of the portrait.

letterConstructionRules: High stroke contrast between thick and thin lines
Large x-height for the display letters
Italicized slant for the bottom text
characterSpecificRedesigns: Display letters are enclosed in individual thin-lined rectangular boxes
Small lowercase versions of the letters appear in the bottom right corner of each box
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Matching serif family using weight and posture (italic vs. roman) to differentiate hierarchy.
graphicDevices: Hand-drawn cross-hair grid over the face
Loose, scribbled perimeter marks around the central square

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the high-contrast, elegant serif look of the display text.
Provides the classic, readable italicized look for the bottom text.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a high-key, off-white paper background. In the center, place a square photographic crop of a pale face (eyes, nose, mouth). Overlay the face with a thin black cross-hair grid and surround the square with loose, faint, hand-drawn charcoal or pencil sketch marks.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add three thin black rectangular boxes at the top center. Inside each box, place a large bold serif letter and a tiny lowercase version in the corner. At the bottom center, add a single line of uppercase italicized serif text with moderate tracking.

verificationChecks: Is the background a clean, off-white space?
Are the top letters individually boxed?
Is the central portrait overlaid with a grid?
Is the bottom text italicized and centered?

postGenerationChecks: Ensure the central square is perfectly centered horizontally.
Check that the grid lines on the face are thin and precise.
Verify the serif fonts have high contrast between thick and thin strokes.
Confirm the background color is a consistent off-white/cream tone.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a central, gridded photographic fragment with expansive white space and structured, high-contrast serif typography for a sophisticated, minimalist editorial look.
